profiles.name: Mohd Shahar Abdullah
profiles.description: Mohd Shahar Abdullah represents Paya Besar, Pahang, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Economy. A UMNO member.

profile_sources.label: UMNO · Paya Besar division chief, 29 July 2026

milestones.title: Carry out a construction-sector reform study under RMK13
milestones.description: Mohd Shahar announced a whole-project-cycle study to strengthen regulatory and legal arrangements for construction and related services.
milestones.progress_note: An announcement of the study is established. Its completion, approved recommendations and implementation were not verified; general developer support is not a measured outcome.

milestones.title: Strengthen the working environment and training for BIM adoption
milestones.description: Mohd Shahar said the government would support Building Information Modelling through facilities, a suitable working environment and training by July 2026.
milestones.progress_note: The month-only schedule uses 31 July as an end-of-month marker. A matching delivery report was not found in this pass; no success or missed-target classification is assumed.

methodology: Dated public commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. An evidence-only record has no invented earlier promise. Status is tied to its evidence snapshot and shared agency responsibility is explicit. Historical activity is not a live November performance measurement. Allocations, attendance, sales orders and unrelated programme ratios are not completion percentages. Additional research may extend this initial pass.
